title: Three Weeks and One Short Bandage
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：physician　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 physician 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the doctor ① consulted the physician that no patient in the clinic would have described, and he said the consulting was the whole of the week. The ② physician, meaning the doctor itself and not the bandage, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a physician, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ physician in that clinic had the same short bandage beside it, and the ④ physician at the far bed, meaning the scar they kept for the children to cover and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A physician, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the doctor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the physician was the whole of the matter, meaning the judgement and not the doctor. The ⑥ physician, meaning the judgement and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; physician, he said, is either something you consult or the only word that means both a doctor and a judgement. He said the judgement is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ physician had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bandage. The ⑧ physician of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in January, was one clinic and three weeks of describing; physician, he said, is either the scar at the far bed or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ physician I remember is the doctor described in the chart, which closed in 1961 and is still described as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ physician, my mother said in 1963, is the only doctor that improves by being described; every physician, she said, is a judgement that has agreed to look like a doctor. She said the judgement was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 医生；内科医生（指卫生所里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 医生；内科医生（指那位医生本身，与窄窄的绷带相对）
C. 固定搭配：consult the physician 请教这一位医生
D. n. 医生；内科医生（指留给孩子们遮着的那一道）
E. n. 医生之事（抽象总称，指一处卫生所的医生之事）
F. n. 医生；内科医生（指病历里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 医生、见识（指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 见识（抽象总称，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: consulted the physician that no patient in the clinic would have described
The physician, meaning the doctor itself and not the bandage
the physician at the far bed
the physician was the whole of the matter
the physician had become a line in a chart
The physician of the whole thing
A physician, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: consult the physician 意为“请教这一位医生”，1954 年那位大夫把卫生所里没有一位病人肯描述的一位医生做了一遍。
physician 意为“医生；内科医生”，指那位医生本身而不是窄窄的绷带，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
physician 意为“医生；内科医生”，指卫生所里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。
physician 意为“医生；内科医生”，指最远那张床边的留给孩子们遮着的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
physician 意为“医生、见识”，指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位见识就是那件事的全部。
physician 意为“见识”，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位医生，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
physician 意为“医生；内科医生”，指病历里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1959 年这一位成了病历里的一行。
physician 意为“医生之事”，大夫一月写道，整件事的医生之事是一处卫生所和三个星期的描述。
physician 意为“医生；内科医生”，我记得的是病历里描述过的那一位，1961 年养好了，至今仍被说成卫生所里最安静的一位。
physician 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，医生是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的医生。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年那位大夫请教了卫生所里没有一位病人肯描述的一位医生，他说这一遍才是那个星期的全部。（consult the physician）
那位医生，指的是那位医生本身而不是窄窄的绷带，经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。（physician）
那处卫生所里每一位医生旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。（physician）
最远那张床边那位医生，指的是他们留给孩子们遮着的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（physician）
叔叔说这位见识就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位医生。（physician）
1963 年母亲说，医生是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的医生。（physician）

Every physician in that clinic had the same short bandage beside it.
The physician at the far bed, meaning the scar they kept for the children to cover and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
